items.statement: Expect healthy growth in operating profit for rest of FY26; no revenue growth guidance given
items.quote: Overall, looking ahead, while the year has begun on a challenging note, we remain firmly focused to deliver healthy growth in operating profit for the rest of FY '26.

items.statement: Gross margin compressed 450bps YoY to ~75% due to non-comparable wine sourcing model change for tourism; normalized gross margin ~80%; expect 200bps operating margin improvement in H2 FY26
items.quote: Adjusting for this one -off, our gross margin remains broadly in line with last year at around 80%. This is a temporary impact and will continue into quarter 2, a much lesser extent. From quarter 3 onwards, this effect will normalize due to a comparable base.

items.statement: Capex to moderate to ~INR 35 crore annually from FY26 onwards, half of INR 50-60 crore per annum over last 3 years
items.quote: We expect capex for FY '26 and onwards to moderate to half of this to around INR35 crores annually. In the last 3 years, it may be noted we have been doing capex to the extent of INR 50 crores to INR 60 crores per annum.

items.statement: New 30-key resort Haven by Sula near York winery opening in Q2 FY26, expanding room capacity by ~30% to 134 keys; first resort with convention facilities
items.quote: The most significant of our upcoming expansion plans is the new 30 key resort coming up near our York winery, which will be known as the Haven by Sula. The new resort is slated to open well in time for this festive season and will expand our room capacity by around 30% to 134 keys.

items.statement: Wine tourism grew >20% YoY in Q1 FY26; resort occupancy 82% vs 70% YoY; spend per guest up 6%; D2C bottle shop sales INR 9 crore, up 11% YoY
items.quote: Our wine tourism business grew strongly by over 20% in Q1. This growth was driven by solid all-round performance as we saw a healthy increase in footfalls and record Q1 resort occupancy and spend per guest.

items.statement: Elite & premium share rose 300bps YoY to 75% of own brand revenue; The Source delivers double-digit growth, contributes ~10% of own brand revenue
items.quote: the contribution of Elite and Premium wines increased by over 300 basis points to 75% of our own brand revenue, up from 71% in quarter 1 last year.

items.statement: COGS up 20%+ YoY due to wine tourism sourcing model change (intra-group to third-party distributor), adding INR 6 crore traded goods purchase; raw material cost reduction initiatives underway but not yet reflected due to higher cost invento
items.quote: This change being non-comparable on a Y-o-Y basis resulted in an increase of INR 6 crores in traded goods purchased, leading to a 450 basis point compression in gross margin.

items.statement: Maharashtra excise duty hike on spirits caused temporary wine disruption in June; EU FTA talks ongoing, no imminent tariff cuts; MIP currently USD 5/bottle CIF for Australia Part 1
items.quote: post the duty hike announcement, distributors substantially front -loaded spirit purchases to take advantage of the pre -revised prices stock. This shift in focus led to a significant reduction in wine offtake during the last 2 weeks of June in Maharashtra

items.statement: Intense discounting (BOGO) by competitors in HoReCa segment; Sula tries to stay above fray but faces pressure; The Source gaining HoReCa listings despite discounting
items.quote: I would use the acronym BOGO, which is buy one, get one, which seems to be the raining mantra right now for a lot of our competition. And sometimes it goes even further than that.

items.statement: WIPS outstanding INR 70 crore end Q1 vs INR 72 crore end March 2025; accrued INR 9.5 crore, received INR 13 crore payout in Q1
items.quote: Our WIPS outstanding at the end of quarter 1 stood at around INR 70 crores compared to around INR 72 crores at the end of March 2025. During the quarter, we accrued around INR 9.5 crores of this accrual. And we also received a INR13 crores payout from the government.

items.statement: Key states West Bengal, Goa, UP, Rajasthan posted healthy double-digit growth despite tepid urban demand; CST portfolio expanded to 9 labels, newly listed wines widely available
items.quote: several key states, including West Bengal, Goa, UP and Rajasthan posted healthy double-digit growth.

items.statement: Potential MIP reduction could increase import competition; global wine oversupply from Chile, Australia, NZ creates aggressive export pricing; export market not remunerative
items.quote: you have countries with very large production like Chile, Australia and New Zealand, where the local consumption doesn't come anywhere close to the production. And so, these countries are very aggressive.

items.statement: Launched Sula Muscat Blanc (7.5% ABV) at INR 875 MRP in Maharashtra; more premium launches planned before festive season; Samruddhi highway Mumbai-Nashik section open, cuts drive time by 45 minutes
items.quote: We have strategically priced the new wine very attractively at an MRP of INR 875 per bottle in Maharashtra. Muscat Blanc will be part of the iconic original Sula Classics range, thus strengthening our premium portfolio.

items.statement: Management expects exit run rate revenue of Rs. 90-100 crores in Q4 FY26
items.quote: Directionally, I think broadly, you are correct.

items.statement: Management targets incremental EBITDA margin of around 20% on additional sales
items.quote: So, generally, the convention in our company for many years has been to try and peg incrementals, okay, that's what we call it, incremental and decremental at or about 20%.

items.statement: EV Transmission volumes expected to ramp up substantially in H2 FY26
items.quote: We anticipate a substantial ramp-up in volumes in the second half of FY '26 led by one of India's leading EV manufacturers, where we are now present across all their EV platforms.

items.statement: Export revenues expected to double in FY26 and grow at 15%+ CAGR over next 3-4 years
items.quote: With multiple contracts already secured and a robust pipeline in place, we believe we are well positioned to double our export revenues in FY '26. Looking ahead, we expect our export revenues to grow at a CAGR of more than 15% over the next three to four years.

items.statement: Secured transfer case contract with Indian OEM for global launch with Rs. 800+ crores lifecycle revenue over 7 years starting H2 FY27
items.quote: We have secured the contract, I think this was announced last year, with an estimated life cycle revenue of over Rs. 800 crores to be executed over a seven-year period, starting from the second half of FY '27.

items.statement: New component programs commenced shipment expected to generate up to Rs. 90 crores annual revenue with 1M+ parts volume
items.quote: I am also pleased to share that we have commenced shipments on several new programs of our components business. This initiative is expected to generate annual revenues of up to Rs. 90 crores with volumes exceeding 1 million parts.

items.statement: Transfer case monthly average volumes rebounded to FY24 levels after prolonged softness
items.quote: The volume offtake in our core segment, transfer cases, has rebounded sharply. Monthly average volumes are now at par with FY '24 levels following a prolonged period of softness over the past more than a year.

items.statement: Components segment grew 72% YoY in Q1 FY26 driven by export volumes
items.quote: This business continued its strong momentum into FY '26, delivering an impressive 72% year-on-year growth in Q1 FY '26, primarily driven by higher volumes coming from exports.

items.statement: EV Transmission volumes remain below potential but recovery expected in H2 FY26
items.quote: While volumes have recovered somewhat, they continue to remain a little indifferent and significantly below what we believe is the true potential of the Indian market.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded to 62.9% in Q1 FY26, up 246 bps YoY
items.quote: Gross margins stood at 62.9% in Q1 of FY '26, expanded by 246 basis points over Q1 of FY '25.

items.statement: EBITDA margin reached 24.9% in Q1 FY26, up 148 bps YoY
items.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 24.9%, expanded by 148 basis over Q1 of FY '25.

items.statement: PAT margin crossed 11.6% in Q1 FY26, up 160 bps YoY
items.quote: PAT margin stands at 11.6%, expanded by 160 basis points over Q1 of 'FY25.

items.statement: Evaluating feasibility of US manufacturing footprint due to tariff risks
items.quote: Which is why in my remarks I mentioned that we are actively investigating a US manufacturing footprint, because we believe that what is underway is a watershed defining moment in global industrial history.

items.statement: Significant unutilized capacity available; improved utilization driving margin expansion
items.quote: I can tell you one thing that this performance is fairly , we still have a lot of capacity in our system, and that's the good news . Because as we use this capacity, the sort of contribution margins, EBITDA, whatever you are calling them is going to go straight to the bottom line.

items.statement: Strategic sourcing and operations exceeded cost reduction targets in Q1 FY26
items.quote: We did not just met our cost reduction targets, but we exceeded them, driving down costs significantly, which, in turn, enabled us to achieve exceptional EBITDA margins for this quarter.

items.statement: Developing 8-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission with deep localization; submitted commercial quote to leading Indian OEM
items.quote: Looking ahead, our key focus in the evolving automatic transmission space now has sort of evolved to looking at the localization of an eight-speed instead of either a six or a seven-speed dual-clutch transmission.

items.statement: Dedicated hybrid transmission (DHT) showed 30%+ efficiency improvement vs conventional ICE in simulation with large SUV OEM
items.quote: These results have demonstrated notable efficiency improvements up to or including more than 30% compared to conventional gasoline ICE configurations.

items.statement: Expanded engagement with leading Indian EV OEM across all platforms; submitted prototype hardware for next platform targeting SOP in H2 FY26
items.quote: In fact, very recently, we submitted the prototype hardwares to the EV customers on this new platform. And once this gets into an SOP in H2 of current year, I would say this will be a record milestone.

items.statement: Received RFQ for 5-speed manual transmission from India's largest commercial truck manufacturer
items.quote: So, we have recently received an RFQ for a five-speed manual transmission from one of India's largest commercial truck manufacturers.

items.statement: Export contribution grew from 1% in FY24 to 5% in FY25 to 11% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: Exports for Q1 FY '26 contribute around 11% of our overall revenue. I am happy to share that our export contribution has grown steadily from just 1% in FY '24 to 5% in FY '25, and it continues to scale up meaningfully.

items.statement: Actively pursuing US manufacturing footprint to mitigate tariff risk; US customers giving more business opportunities
items.quote: And in contrast to what you are hearing, our customer, in fact, is giving us more and more opportunities for new business. And as we speak, we are getting volume ramp-up request from them.

items.statement: New CAFE norms and Bharat Stage emission norms evolution imminent, driving 8-speed DCT localization
items.quote: As some of you may know, new CAFE -norms and further evolution on the Bharat Stage emission norms is likely to come, it's imminent.

items.statement: US tariff escalation (25-50%) poses long-term threat; monitoring dollar depreciation and geopolitical dislocation scenarios
items.quote: One of our risk scenarios that we have been monitoring in our Risk Committee of our Board is such possibilities. One of them is a depreciating dollar. What do you do if the dollar suddenly depreciates? And the other one is the tariff, something goes wrong in tariffs, or there is some other kind of geopolitical dislocation.

items.statement: Achieved zero PPM quality track record in export parts and transfer case supplies in Q1 FY26
items.quote: We proudly maintained zero PPM quality track record in our export parts and transfer case supplies.

items.statement: Maintained 100% on-time delivery to all customers in Q1 FY26
items.quote: What makes this achievement even more commendable is that we also maintained 100% on-time delivery to all our customers, a critical KPI in our business.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 revenue grew ~50% YoY driven by robust export demand from Southeast Asia, Middle East and West Africa
items.quote: This growth was supported by the robust export demand with us for our high-quality product from Southeast Asian market, Middle East and West Africa.

items.statement: Received approval to supply products to Cuba, marking first entry into Latin America
items.quote: I would also like to inform you that in the recent time, we have achieved the approval to supply product in Latin America country named Cuba.

items.statement: EBITDA increased to INR 179 million from INR 104.8 million YoY, reflecting high livestock procurement cost
items.quote: I would like to tell you about the EBITDA of the same quarter it’s INR 179 million, which was in the same last quarter was INR 104.8 million, reflecting our management high live- stock procurement cost

items.statement: Raw material cost for live buffalo increased this quarter, impacting margins
items.quote: The raw material, which we used to make our product, final product, has become a bit expensive in this quarter.

items.statement: Approximately 95% of revenue comes from exports
items.quote: Our I think almost 95% revenue is from exports.

items.statement: Buffalo meat contributes 85-90% of revenue; seafood, sheep, goat and rice make up the rest
items.quote: That is somewhere around 85 or 90% And, Sanket, I think we have a time limit for this conference call.

items.statement: Small technology upgradation capex of around INR 7-8 crores underway; some equipment installed, some awaiting shipment
items.quote: CapEx, the company is building actually, we are making small upgradation. It's not a big amount for machine leak. Some of them has already installed, and some of them had all need to be imported.

items.statement: Capacity utilization at 45-65% for main business and 60-65% for rice; beef capacity varies seasonally
items.quote: Somewhere around 45 to 65% for our main business we are using. And for rice, we are using almost 60 -65%.

items.statement: Industry aims to raise prices but Brazil-US tariff war limits Brazil's price increases; India not directly exporting meat for human consumption to US
items.quote: Actually, the head-to-head com- petition of India is with Brazil. Brazil and the US is under trade tariff war. So, US has put tariff on Brazil, and Brazil has a good supply for US market. So, they are not increasing their price that much

items.statement: Key challenges include uncertain freight charges, geopolitical shipping restrictions (Red Sea), and global warming/weather changes
items.quote: In India challenges we are still seeing the freight charges because the shipping cost is very uncertain, which has made a huge impact on our delivery, our costing, and also the geopolitical situation.

items.statement: Targeting $1 billion revenue; hopes to achieve it this year but cannot predict; Q1 performance provides strong backing
items.quote: We are trying our best, and we hope to achieve it as fast as possible. As we see the first quarter, there is a strong positive reply from the market. I cannot predict it will be this year, but it has to be achieved because this is, will give us more strong support, insight support to build another next target.

items.statement: Growth driven by existing clients' trust in brand, quality, delivery speed and cold chain reliability; new clients follow established importers
items.quote: If your product acceptance is very good in consumer, so all the importer and all the player of supply chain, they only prefer to buy from the one who is more famous, who is faster in delivery, who is more committed to the continuity of their business and we are in the cold chain business.

items.statement: India's main competitor is Brazil; Brazil-US tariff war may create opportunities for India in GCC, Southeast Asia and West Africa markets
items.quote: If, because, US is not only putting tariff on, one side, they are putting tariff on another countries. So if there is a tariff war between, another country, let's say, GCC or Southeast Asia, so they will not buy US product. So, we definitely get a chance to serve them in Central Asia market or GCP market or West African market.

items.statement: India not approved for direct human consumption meat exports to US; only pet food items allowed
items.quote: No, India don't supply to US. India is still not making any meat business for human consumption to US. It is still not allowed to supply for human consumption.

items.statement: Seafood sales seasonal; season starts late September/October; targeting better performance than last year
items.quote: For another product like seafood rice so we have a target to increase this, but this quarter is not for seafood, basically, because this is not seafood season. So, we can only predict our seafood sale after the seafood season started in late September and October.

items.statement: FY26 guidance of INR125 billion presales and INR48 billion revenue recognition
items.value: INR125 billion presales, INR48 billion revenue
items.quote: we are confident to reaching our FY '26 guidance. This includes INR125 billion in presales and INR48 billion in revenue recognition and the growth across the key metrics.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 presales of INR2,600+ crores with 775 units sold at average ticket size INR3.4 crores
items.quote: we've achieved around INR2,600-plus crores of presales during this quarter. To break it down a little, we sold a little above 775 units with an average ticket size of about INR3.4 crores per unit.

items.statement: Cloverdale pricing 12-12.5% higher than Titanium launched a year ago
items.quote: We also did manage to get some good price rise vis-a-vis the previous year Cloverdale, I would say, is about 12%, 12.5% more expensive than Titanium, which we had done a year ago.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 construction and approval spend over INR500 crores
items.quote: We've also spent more than INR500-odd crores within this quarter on construction and approval side.

items.statement: Target to launch 10-11 million sq ft with GDV ~INR17,000 crores in FY26
items.quote: we've taken, I would say, a fairly good stroke ambitious target for this year to launch more than 10 million square foot of new projects across various key markets of ours in the Gurgaon and Sohna market. And by and large, the GDV of this particular 10 million-plus launch will -- 10 million to 11 million square foot of launch would be closer to about INR17,000 crores.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 launched 2 million+ sq ft with GDV ~INR4,000 crores
items.quote: by and large, during this quarter, we've done about 2 million-plus square foot of new launches with a GDV of about INR4,000 odd crores.

items.statement: Completed 1.4 million+ sq ft and handed over 2,000+ apartments in Q1 FY26
items.quote: we've done more than 1.4 million square foot of completion and handed over more than 2,000 apartments to our customers and very pleased that more than 2,000 apartments have been delivered within this quarter itself.

items.statement: Completed projects mix: 45% affordable, 55% mid-income at INR6,000-6,500/sq ft realization
items.quote: Amongst the projects completed about 45% in area terms was of AHP projects and about 55% came from the mid-income segment. And per square foot average realization of these units, which got completed were in about the INR6,000 to INR6,500 per square foot price points.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 revenue recognition INR8.7 billion with 27% gross margin, 11% EBITDA margin, 4% PAT margin
items.quote: As an outcome to the completions we've done, which was roughly about 1.44 million square foot, we did a revenue recognition of about INR8.7 billion, wherein we earned a gross profit margin of about 27%. EBITDA margin was around 11% and PAT margin was around 4%.

items.statement: Incremental construction debt at 9-9.5%; board and shareholder approval for listed NCDs; CARE rating A+
items.quote: Incremental construction debt, which is being raised by the company is coming at a lower price. It's in that 9%, 9.5-odd percent range, we are managing to raise new construction finance loans. And we also plan to open a new tap, a new methodology of raising credit, which is by doing listed nonconvertible debentures. We've already gotten approvals from our Board and from the shareholders to raise a

items.statement: Q1 FY26 collections ~INR930 crores; construction spend ~INR500 crores; surplus ~INR200 crores
items.quote: In terms of collections, we've collected -- we were a little short of INR1,000 crores. We achieved around INR930 crores of collections. The business activity is going very well. We spent more than INR500-odd crores on construction and approvals and created a surplus of close to INR200-odd crores.

items.statement: Construction spend expected to reach INR700-800 crores/quarter in coming calendar year
items.quote: INR700 crores, INR800 crores per quarter does not seem to be like a very steep target. We'll achieve it towards, let's say, in the coming calendar year, we'll be reaching those quarterly numbers.

items.statement: Market demand more mature and predictable vs euphoric investor-led demand last year
items.quote: Right now, I would say it's more mature, the market is behaving in a more predictable manner that if you're launching a housing project where the average ticket size of unit is between INR3 crores to INR4 crores which is not very steep, but yes, it's not like very low as well.

items.statement: Sector 71: 70 acres remaining of 93 acres; potential for additional 3-4M sq ft beyond current land bank
items.quote: out of this 93 acres, the Titanium and Cloverdale put together is about 21, 22 acres, okay? So we're still left with 70 acres. I would -- it's safe to say that a bulk of the land is still unutilized in Sector 71. After -- beyond this 93 acres also, there is a potential to acquire some more land parcels. We can definitely add another 3 million to 4 million square foot worth of developable potential

items.statement: Deluxe DXP: collected INR850+ crores since May 2024 launch; spent INR200+ crores construction; EDC/IDC fully paid
items.quote: Deluxe DXP, we've collected, let's say, we launched it in last May 2024. We've collected close to, let's say, INR850-odd crores since then within that single project. And in terms of hard construction itself, we would have spent more than INR200-odd crores. We've incurred more than, let's say, INR100-odd crores in terms of EDC/IDC costs. So we've fully paid the EDC/IDC cost.

items.statement: Titanium: collected INR450-500 crores since June 2024 launch; spent INR100+ crores construction
items.quote: As far as Titanium is concerned, we've collected between INR450 crores to INR500-odd crores. This project was launched in June last year. At the same time, we've spent more than INR100 crores on construction of this project and multiple other expenses have been incurred to fast pace the construction on this.

items.statement: FY26 pre-sales target of INR 6,000 crores, representing 15% to 20% growth over FY25
items.quote: We plan to launch Rs. 9,500 crores of new projects or GDV in the second half of this year across three projects and across two micro-markets, one in Gurgaon and two in Noida and target of FY26 pre-sales of INR 6,000 crores which was our original guidance as well, representing 15% to 20% growth over FY25.

items.statement: Medium-term target of cumulative pre-sales of Rs. 21,000 crores by FY28 at 15%-20% CAGR
items.quote: On a medium-term basis, we target cumulative pre-sales of Rs. 21,000 crores by FY28, growing at a 15%-20% CAGR.

items.statement: Commercial portfolio annuity rental income potential of over Rs. 700 crores over next 5 years at peak occupancy
items.quote: We are poised for an annuity rental income potential of over Rs. 700 crores over the next 5 years, basis peak occupancy of projects currently in the portfolio.

items.statement: Cumulative pre-sales of more than Rs. 7,300 crores in 2 years with Rs. 1,800 crores collected at 96%+ collection efficiency
items.quote: I am delighted to share that till date we have recorded cumulative pre-sales of more than Rs. 7,300 crores in just 2 years for which the projects are under implementation. Of this, we have already collected close to Rs. 1,800 crores with a collection efficiency of more than 96%.

items.statement: Estate 128 Phase-1 and Phase-2: Rs. 2,700+ crores pre-sales, 100% sold out, Rs. 905 crores collected
items.quote: First, Estate 128 Noida, both in Phase-1 and Phase-2, having booked more than Rs. 2,700 crores of pre-sales, 100% sold out, we have collected Rs. 905 crores till date already.

items.statement: Estate 360 Gurgaon: Rs. 4,600 crores pre-sales, 98% sold, Rs. 900 crores collected as of June 2025
items.quote: Estate 360 in Gurgaon recorded pre-sales value of Rs. 4,600 crores approximately, with 98% of the projects sold as of 30th of June. The project has already received a collection of close to Rs. 900 crores as of June '25.

items.statement: FY26 business development outlay expected in range of Rs. 500 to 800 crores
items.quote: What we are expecting to spend is a number in the range of Rs. 500 to 800 crores in the BD in the current year.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 land spend of ~Rs. 200 crores for Delhi One acquisition and construction spend of ~Rs. 150 crores across all assets
items.quote: In terms of our spending in the current quarter on the land, we had taken over the Delhi One asset, which had entailed we are putting in close to Rs. 200 crores for acquisition for the Delhi One asset. And then overall construction spent across all assets would be in the range of Rs. 150 crores, which got spent in the current quarter.

items.statement: FY26 residential construction deployment estimated at Rs. 450-500 crores
items.quote: And the total deployment across the estate in terms of construction would be in the range of Rs. 450 to 500 crores.

items.statement: Estate 361 Gurgaon (18 acres, 4 msf, GDV Rs. 9,000 crores) planned for Q3 FY26 launch
items.quote: Max Estates joined development in Gurgaon on land parcel of 18 acres having a potential of 4 million square feet adjacent to the already successfully launched Estate 360 project has a GDV potential of Rs. 9,000 crores and is planned to be launched in Q3 of FY26.

items.statement: Delhi One Noida (2.5 msf, GDV Rs. 2,000 crores, annuity Rs. 220 crores) planned for Q4 FY26 launch
items.quote: The project planned to be launched in Q4 of FY26 has a gross development value of Rs. 2,000 crores as well as an annuity income potential of Rs. 220 crores annually.

items.statement: Sector 105 Noida (10 acres, GDV Rs. 3,000 crores, annuity Rs. 150 crores) planned for Q4 FY26 launch
items.quote: This project has a gross development value of approximately Rs. 3,000 crores and an annuity annual rental income potential of approximately Rs. 150 crores. This project is also expected to be launched in Q4 of FY26.

items.statement: Max Square Two Noida (1 msf leasable) OC expected Q2 FY28, annual rental >Rs. 110 crores
items.quote: Max Square Two, Noida, project having a leasable area of 1 million square feet is on track and is expected to receive occupancy certificate by Quarter 2 of financial year '28. The project is expected to yield an annual rental in excess of Rs. 110 crores.

items.statement: Max 65 Gurgaon (1.6 msf leasable) OC in two phases: 40% by Q2 FY28, balance by Q3 FY29, annual rental >Rs. 200 crores
items.quote: Max 65 at Sector 65 Gurgaon having a leasable area of 1.6 million square feet is on track and is expected to receive occupancy certificate in two phases. First Phase-of 40% by Quarter 2 of FY28 and the second Phase-by Quarter 3 of FY29, respectively. The project cumulatively is expected to have an annual rental in excess of Rs. 200 crores.

items.statement: Estate 128 (outright) EBITDA margin guidance 40%-45%; Estate 360 (JDA) EBITDA margin guidance 20%-25%
items.quote: One is outright, which is Estate 128. We have given guidance with a margin of 40% to 45% in that. And in the case of Estate 360, which is a joint development agreement construct, we have given guidance of 20%-25% EBITDA margins in that.

items.statement: Upcoming launches: Sector 105 (outright) EBITDA margin 25%-30%; Estate 361 (JDA) EBITDA margin 15%-20%
items.quote: In this, again, we would, what we are guiding is that we would be looking at an outright project. Our guidance is that an outright would have a margin, which would be in the range of 25 to 30%. Our launch in Sector 105 is outright. And in the case of 361, which is a JDA, we would be looking at the margins in the range of 15% to 20%.

items.statement: Estate 360 base price increased from Rs. 18,000-19,000/sqft to ~Rs. 22,000/sqft in 6-8 months; future pricing growth underwritten at early double-digit
items.quote: We launched sales in Estate 360 at, if I am not mistaken, a price of Rs. 18,000 to 19,000 square feet. And we are currently seeing a large transaction close to Rs. 22,000 a square foot. So, in a short span of almost 6-7-8 months, there is also, it's not a flattish curve, it's an increasing, it's an increasing curve.

items.statement: Going forward, pricing growth underwritten at conservative early double-digit levels, not a repeat of past exceptional run
items.quote: Going forward, we don't expect a repeat of same pricing increase to happen. And we would like to underwrite a much more conservative, if I can say, early double-digit kind of growth prices happening in the pricing.

items.statement: NCR residential: ultra-premium (Rs. 5 Cr+) volume sales grew 9% to ~5,200 units in H1 CY25; NCR 65% share of top 7 cities premium/luxury sales
items.quote: Ultra-premium homes priced at Rs. 5 crores and above continue to attract high-end buyers with volume sales growing by 9% to 5,200 units approximately in the first half of the year. Across the top seven cities, Delhi NCR accounted for 65% share of the total premium and luxury sales.

items.statement: Commercial portfolio 100% leased across Max Towers, Max House, Max Square; Adobe leased 23% of Max Square at 30% premium to micro-market
items.quote: Max Square has also achieved 100% occupancy within a year of its launch with a recent lease of 23% area to a marquee lessee, Adobe, commanding a 30% premium to the micro-market, showing strong leasing traction.

items.statement: Commercial tenant mix diversified across BFSI, professional services, law firms; no single tenant >20% in any asset; IT exposure in low single digits
items.quote: We have a very diverse mix of clientele. So, we are across BFSI, professional services, law firms, and we are very-very-very well diversified, both in every asset and in the overall portfolio. So, in one particular asset, nobody takes more than 20% of the overall building.

items.statement: Residential collections: Rs. 360 crores in Q1 FY26 (mainly Estate 128 tranche 2); FY26 expected Rs. 2,500-2,600 crores total collections
items.quote: In terms of what we have already collected in the first quarter is a number of Rs. 360 crores, which is predominantly by the second tranche collection for Estate 128. In the current year, we are expecting another tranche of collection to happen in Estate 360, which would be close to Rs. 900 crores. And so, in total, we would be expecting a number close to Rs. 1,200 to 1,300 coming from the existin

items.statement: Gross debt Rs. 1,406 crores, cash Rs. 1,578 crores, net cash Rs. 172 crores as of June 30; Max Estates share Rs. 837 crores, NYL share Rs. 730 crores
items.quote: As on 30th June, the gross debt of the company stood at Rs. 1,406 crores with a cash balance of Rs. 1,578 crores. We had net cash of Rs. 172 crores. Further, of the debt of Rs. 1,578 crores, share of Max Estates stood at Rs. 837 crores, with a balance of Rs. 730 crores representing the share of New York Life in the commercial estate.

items.statement: At full commercial portfolio stabilization (Rs. 700 Cr rental), expected consolidated debt ~Rs. 1,500 crores, Max Estates share ~Rs. 750 crores (51%)
items.quote: Once we have all the assets completed under construction and the lease rental flowing of Rs. 700 crores, our construction finances would have been converted into LRD and our existing LRDs would have got significantly paid down. items.quote: We are excited about the launch of Suraksha Genomics, a dedicated vertical offering advanced genetic and molecular testing services. You would be kind enough to note that this is the first complete genomic laboratory facility which is available in the whole of Eastern India.

items.statement: Manpower scarcity for qualified genomic professionals (PhDs, bioinformatic engineers) identified as biggest challenge for genomics scaling
items.quote: The biggest challenge in this is the manpower. Technically, relevant, qualified people are very limited in this study.

items.statement: B2B esoteric genomic tests (NIPT, microarray, oncology panels) not discounted like collection center B2B, margin differential vs B2C not meaningful

items.quote: Looking ahead, we expect our EBITDA and PAT margin to improve as our center scale and mature. With higher throughput, improved operating leverage and tighter cost control, we anticipate meaningful margin expansion, especially in our mature centers.

items.statement: Targets 30-35% revenue growth over next three years and profitability enhancement of 3-4%
items.quote: we are confident of maintaining our target at 30-35% growth over the next three years, while enhancing profitability by over 3-4%.
