items.statement: Inquiry levels started normalizing in last 10-20 days; expect demand momentum to improve from Q2 with retreating monsoons, festive season, better liquidity and credit availability
items.quote: Going forward, with retreating monsoons, early festive season, better liquidity and consumer credit availability, we expect the dema nd momentum to improve across our product range

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded ~300 bps to 20.28% in Q1 FY26 driven by cost efficiencies, soft commodity prices, price increases, and higher other income
items.quote: Despite the challenges, our margin profile expanded by almost 300 basis points and the EBITDA increased by more tha n 13.6% to Rs . 142.55 crores as against Rs . 125.5 crores. The EBITDA for the quarter stood at 20.28

items.statement: Overall margins expected to stabilize around 16%-17% for the year; export margins slightly better than domestic
items.quote: I believe that they should stabilize for overall margins somewhere around 16%-17%.

items.statement: Gross margins of 33%-35% sustainable; Q1 gross margin ~34% driven mainly by pricing increases and accommodative commodity prices
items.quote: I think this is totally sustainable and as we have communicated earlier. So, I think around gross margins of anywhere between 33% to 35%, lets say, 34%, what you mentioned is actually the ballpoint plus minus a percentage from there are sustainable.

items.statement: Price increases of 7%-12% across majority product categories due to CEV Stage V norms and safety certification; BS III to BS V machines up 12%-13%, BS IV to BS V up 6%-7%
items.quote: These regulatory changes have led to a consequential price increase of 7% to 12% across majority categories of

items.statement: No further price increases expected in current year unless swift movement in steel or major commodity prices; annual inflation-linked increase typically in January
items.quote: So, apart from what we have done in April, I don't see any price increase till December and the commodity prices also as of now remain reasonably under control. So, I see no need for pricing.

items.statement: Defence: single largest order received last quarter; execution starts Q3 small way, picks up Q4; expect Rs 50-70 cr this year, ~Rs 200 cr next year, balance thereafter
items.quote: So, hopefully in Quarter 3 we'll start executing and it will pick up steam in Quarter 4. So, we'll get some contribution within this year from maybe about Rs. 50 crores-Rs. 60 crores-Rs. 70 crores of business we'll be doing out of this order in this year and most of it will go into the next year.

items.statement: Additional defence orders: ~Rs 45-50 cr with Ashok Leyland confirmed, another ~Rs 70-80 cr (90 machines) on anvil; pipeline of 3%-4% yearly revenue
items.quote: So, the order we are about to get is again a good order not very big but let's say close to about 45 crores-50 crores, it's already done. And another one, similar one another 90 odd machines after this which would be again close to 70 crores-80 crores is on the anvil.

items.statement: Ghana project in limbo for 1.5-2 years; funding stopped despite Exim Bank agreement; no visibility currently
items.quote: I think it is in a limbo as of now. It has been like that for the last 1.5-2 years and till such time there is financial clarity, w e really don't know how to proceed about it although our agreement with the Exim Bank of India and the three-party agreement everything is in place but the funding has been stopped

items.statement: Export revenue ~Rs 27 cr in Q1 FY26; targeting 6%-7% of total revenue this year (up from 4% last year); combined with defence aim for ~10% contribution
items.quote: I think the export revenue in the current quarter was close to around Rs. 27 crores and it is shaping up well. So, in terms of what our expectation for the whole year for export, last year we had gone down to 4% of to our total revenue contribution and this year it appears that it can easily go up to 6%-7%.

items.statement: Bauma Munich participation yielded good response; established new European dealerships especially for orchard tractor; planning Agritechnica participation in 2-3 months
items.quote: We have established a couple of new ones and we have also been able to establish a couple of dealerships within Europe as well, especially for our smaller tractor, the orchard tractor which is which is very popular there.

items.statement: Current revenue capacity ~Rs 5,000 cr+; operated ~Rs 3,300 cr in FY25; 30%-40% excess capacity available without significant capex; 138 acres land acquired for future expansion
items.quote: We have increased our capacities, we are capable of Rs. 5,000 crores plus. We did close to Rs. 3,300 crores. So, we have excess capacity available. Apart from that we are operating around close to about 100 acres of land, for future growth and expansion we have taken about 138 acres of land.

items.statement: New plant for particular product entry to add ~Rs 1,500 cr revenue capacity; start next year (FY27) once more certainty; capex-to-revenue capability ~8x-9x
items.quote: But in any case in the next year we will start to expand our capacity which I did mention making a new plant for particular type of product entry, so which will give us an additional revenue of maybe around close to Rs. 1,500 crores plus minus, but that will start to do next year.

items.statement: CEV Stage V emission norms and enhanced safety certification implemented; aligned industry with global benchmarks; caused 7%-12% price increases
items.quote: This was primarily driven by the implement ation of CEV S tage V emission norms and enhanced safety certification requirements, which have aligned our industry with global

items.statement: Market share in new generation pick & carry cranes ~50%-51% (similar to Escorts); in hydra type (55%-60% of market) share 70%-75%; temporary share loss due to hydra segment shrinkage from BS V transition
items.quote: Within the new generation the market share between the Escorts and our company is similar. W e are about 50 %-51% rather, they're close to over that 49%-50%. And the other typ e which is about I would say 55% -60% of the market, the hydra type, there our market share is 70% plus

items.statement: Chinese excavators gained 25%-30% share in 4-5 years; unchecked could reach 50%-60% and make industry sick; government action on tariffs/non-tariff barriers underway
items.quote: If you look at the excavator industry, Chinese entered 5-7 years back and in 4-5 years, 6 years they have taken 25%-30% market share. So, if they are not checked today, they will go to 50%-60% and eventually they will make the industry, excavator industry sick.

items.statement: Actively working on inorganic growth proposals; hope to update in next 1-2 quarters when concrete; also exploring organic and white labeling (one large white label proposal suspended due to Trump tariffs)
items.quote: Now, we are looking at inorganic growth and we are working very actively on some proposals. So, hopefully over the next 1 or 2 quarters as things progress we would like to update as and when know there is something concrete.

items.statement: Kato JV agreement expected to conclude this quarter or early next; targeting work start in Q3
items.quote: It is very much under progre ss and we are hopeful that within this quarter or early next quarter, the agreement would be concluded in totality and work can start . So, we are targeting to start work in Quarter 3

items.statement: Construction equipment & road machinery segment expected to grow 30%-40% this year; Minister Gadkari indicated 2 lakh cr orders released, 7 lakh cr more soon, 10 lakh cr planned next year
items.quote: See construction equipment and road machinery side of our business we are hopeful that that should be able to grow at least 30%-40% this year and only 3-4 days back our minister Mr. Gadkari, Minister for Road transport and Highway, he's conveyed that the process for releasing orders for roads and all going to be sped out very quickly.

items.statement: Indo-Pak border tensions and global uncertainties weakening customer sentiment towards capital investments; Trump tariffs suspended a large white labeling proposal
items.quote: Additionally, the Indo-Pak border tensions and prevailing global uncertainties have further weakened customer sentiment towards capital investments.

items.statement: Electric crane approvals pending with ARAI/CMVR; Exide battery approvals pending; hopeful to clear quickly
items.quote: Our approvals are pending with the ARAI, the CMVR authority. I think last hitch some Exide battery approvals with respect to electric vehicles are pending at the end of Exide, so we are hopeful it should get through quickly.

items.statement: Vahan registration data lags wholesale dispatches by 1.5-2 months; excludes tower cranes, crawler cranes, some forklifts; not exact parameter for company volumes
items.quote: I think there is a lag of one-to-two months at least. Minimum would be one month, average put out you can easily say 45 days to 60 days because they are delivered to the dealerships then to the customer and then the registration application so the Vahan data is representative but not of the current factual.

items.statement: Sales growth target of 15% to 20% for FY26
items.quote: organically, we have always maintained that we will grow at 15% to 20%. That is the benchmark that we have set for ourselves.

items.statement: LED share expected to reach 75%-80% in next couple of years
items.quote: we believe that this number should gradually move up 75% - 80% over the next couple of years and that will drive this revenue growth

items.statement: Capex guidance of Rs. 75-100 crore for FY26
items.quote: the total CAPEX, if I was to highlight for the current year is around Rs. 75 crores to Rs. 100 crores. This includes everything.

items.statement: Rs. 200 crore capex plan over next three years excluding four-wheeler
items.quote: the CAPEX plan of Rs. 200 crores over next three years excluding anything that we do for four-wheeler remains intact.

items.statement: Plan to add 10 SMT lines in next one year, currently have 10
items.quote: We have 10 SMT lines in our company and we are planning for another 10 machines in next one year.

items.statement: EMC/EMI lab under installation, to be commissioned next quarter
items.quote: in next quarter we should be commissioning this facility integration of electronics, optics, thermal, mechanical all at one location

items.statement: Received development orders for three products from Force Motors
items.quote: we have received development orders for three additional products from Force Motors. Our engagement with the customer on new technology is progressing well.

items.statement: RFQs worth Rs. 700 crore for four-wheeler progressing to technical studies
items.quote: We continue to work on those RFQs, and they have moved to the next step the technical studies are on alongside the customer.

items.statement: Two-wheeler industry demand projected at 6% to 10% for the year
items.quote: generally the two-wheeler demand seems to be robust for the year and, as per projection, the range is anywhere from 6% to 10% …is what is being projected by the industry.

items.statement: Demand seems fairly robust with good monsoon and festive season
items.quote: Overall what we see on the ground, the demand seems to be fairly robust. Festive season is coming on, monsoon has been good.

items.statement: EBITDA margin stable at similar level for LED and non-LED products
items.quote: at a margin level, we are going to be at similar level, be it LED or non LED products. So, margins have not changed, but sales velocity definitely increases.

items.statement: Gross margins largely stable, cost changes passed to customers
items.quote: So, they have been largely stable and we have been able to manage with any vagaries with the customers. We have kind of told you in the past as well that any cost increase decrease is all passed on to customers.

items.statement: No impact from rare earth metals as EV exposure is small
items.quote: rare earth eventually there is some exposure on the EV side only and EV as right now is fairly small component of the industry. So, we are not seeing any major impact specifically around it right now.

items.statement: No supply chain impact from glass imports, using polycarbonate and PMMA
items.quote: We are not using glasses in our lamps. It is all being polycarbonate and PMMA material is being used, not the glass.

items.statement: LED lighting share at 63.92% of automotive lighting sales in Q1 FY26
items.quote: LED lighting share in total automotive lighting stands at 63.92%.

items.statement: Non-LED portfolio stable at Rs. 170-180 crore, pipeline 100% LED
items.quote: we are currently at 64% as our total automotive sales and this will continue to go up. And over the next couple of years, this number should increasingly go up because our pipeline is 100% LED

items.statement: No share loss with HMSI, volumes flat
items.quote: No, we have not lost any share from HMSI. And wherever there are few products which are already in development as of now at our end, will be launched during next year.

items.statement: Hero business on track per event plan, new projects ramping up
items.quote: whatever business is being taken by us from Hero is as per their event plan is on-track.

items.statement: Yamaha sales up 20% YoY in Q1, driven by domestic and export models
items.quote: our Yamaha sale in Q1 as compared to Q1 of last year, is almost up 20%. So, for us, there is an industry decline in domestic that you are talking about. But we have not seen that.

items.statement: Mahindra commercial production commenced in Q1, Bolero products in development
items.quote: we have commenced our commercial production for Mahindra in this quarter the quarter that has just gone. And our first product which is LED license plate lamp that is already getting applied to almost all models of Mahindra

items.statement: Hero 125R LED lighting launch in couple of months
items.quote: This will be a new model launch which will be soon, might be in a couple of months, it will be launched in upcoming models.

items.statement: US tariffs not impacting directly or indirectly, contracts on FOB basis
items.quote: tariffs are only applicable to United States and our business directly with United States is very marginal, not significant. And even where there is that business, our contract terms are FOB where we are not impacted

items.statement: Cash balance of Rs. 341 crore at end of Q1 FY26
items.quote: So, as of end of quarter, the cash balance is Rs. 341 crores.

items.statement: Industry volume growth benchmark of 6% to 8% factored into sales guidance
items.quote: we are taking the industry benchmark of 6% to 8% growth which is what the industry is projecting.

items.statement: No demand challenges seen on ground despite global headwinds
items.quote: While you see all the headlines on tariffs and all, we have got upgraded recently by rating agency as India. So, I think structurally we are fine. We are not seeing any challenges on the ground.

items.statement: Management expects roughly 8% to 10% top-line growth in FY26 and margins better than FY25.
items.quote: We feel that roughly 8% to 10% upside in the top line in the FY'26. As regard the margin, it will be better than what we have already given for the year.

items.statement: Palghar facility land acquisition delayed; revised timeline Q4 FY27 with total investment around Rs. 100 crore, Rs. 50 crore already spent.
items.quote: As we stated earlier, there is a delay in land acquisition and still it is going on particularly in the Palghar facility and the revised timeline for that is Q4 of FY '27 and the total investment would be around Rs. 100 crore and out of which Rs. 50 crore is already spent.

items.statement: Non-asbestos portfolio expected to double in 3-4 years, led by fireproof and waterproof products.
items.quote: Now, for the next 3 years, it appears to me is what the industry at present is, maybe double than from here after 3 to 4 years.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 EBITDA margin 10.1%, down from 11.4% YoY but up from 9.1% QoQ.
items.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 10.1% compared to 11.4% YOY and 9.1% quarter-on-quarter basis.

items.statement: Q1 sales partially impacted by early monsoon onset in May and subdued roofing demand.
items.quote: The sales during the quarter were partially impacted by the early onset of monsoon, especially in the month of May, along with subdued demands in roofing.

items.statement: Geopolitical instability and dollar-rupee volatility remain key challenges for raw material costs.
items.quote: See, the point is, the geopolitical situation at present, the steady business is going on and where the dollar -rupee will go, it's very difficult to answer. So, that's a big challenge as of today.

items.statement: Raw material prices largely stabilized except minor 1% fluctuations expected in coming quarters.
items.quote: Considering that, I think raw material prices by and large is stabilized, except 1% here and there always happens in the coming the quarters, that is the ongoing process.

items.statement: Capacity utilization improved to 93% in Q1 FY26 from 89% in Q1 FY25.
items.quote: On the operational front, capacity utilization improved from 93% in Q1 FY '26 up from 89% in Q1 FY'25.

items.statement: Targets double-digit growth in premium products and 10% top-line growth for FY26
items.quote: So talking about the future outlook, I would like to continue with the double-digit growth in the premium products. We've already said that it will be a decent double-digit growth, and we still maintain that.

items.statement: Targets 100 bps EBITDA margin improvement annually over 2-3 years
items.quote: And for the years to come, definitely, we keep a target of 100 basis points, but it will be a little ugly if I say 100 basis points every year. But it looks possible actually to me if we talk about 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: Expects INR100 cr revenue from Kaeros in FY26 and INR150-200 cr in FY27
items.quote: But I can say that in FY '27, we should be able to do about INR150 crores to INR200 crores from Kaeros. And this year, I don't want to give a number, but definitely, we'll be targeting about INR100 crores business from Kaeros in totality.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 EBITDA margin improved to 12% from 11% YoY
items.quote: The EBITDA margin of the company in Q1 has grown up by almost 12% versus 11% in the last year.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded to 29.2% from 27.6% YoY in Q1 FY26
items.quote: Gross profit has increased from INR181 crores to INR202 crores, so from 27.6% to 29.2%.

items.statement: Strong demand in rice and maize herbicides; cotton and soybean herbicides impacted by dry spells
items.quote: But if you look at the crops like rice and maize, so they are very healthy and they are going very strong. The rains have been patchy, which has affec ted also in some parts of the country, particularly pulses, cotton and oilseeds

items.statement: Factories running at 100% capacity, unable to fully meet market demand in July-August
items.quote: At this moment, with all the factories running at 100% capacity, we are not able to fulfill the market demand. Demand is like that.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 sales from FY25 launches reached INR42 cr vs INR34 cr for full FY25
items.quote: INR42 crores sales from last year's launches was there in Q1, whereas in the last full year, the total sale was just INR34 crores.

items.statement: Altair targets 0.5 million acres at maturity, ~INR70 cr revenue potential
items.quote: Going forward in 2 to 3 years' time frame, our maturity volumes stand at hitting roughly 0.5 million acres. That is the target which we are chasing and we are investing for.

items.statement: Dahej Part 1 technical plant operational; Sotanala formulation unit targets next kharif, technical plant Phase 1 by end of next fiscal
items.quote: We have completed our capex of Dahej Part 1. So the technical plant has already started the production. And now we are working on Sotanala, which is going to support us for further expansions.

items.statement: Added almost 100 reactors at Dahej; depreciation impact visible at year-end
items.quote: We have just capitalized it because we have just completed the addition of almost 100 reactors in our system.

items.statement: Premium products grew ~20% in Q1; B2C mix 58% premium, 42% generic; B2C 75% of total sales
items.quote: So coming down to the results of the Q1, the premium products in the Q1 has grown by almost 20%. So when I say premium products, they are Focused Maharatnas and the Maharatna.

items.statement: B2B sales down 8-9% in Q1; expects recovery in Q2 to beat last year's H1 and Q2 levels
items.quote: This year, again, yes, we have lost 10% -- a little lesser, 8%, 9% sales are lesser in B2B segment, and we have got about 8%, 9% -- no, a little more 12% growth in the B2C business.

items.statement: Raw material prices broadly stable, near bottom; minimal fluctuations
items.quote: Broadly, they have been very, very stable. There was a decline in the prices after COVID. After that, they are stable. Some small rise sometimes in some product s and -- but more or less, I would say that they are near the bottom

items.statement: Imports typically INR500-600 cr annually; continuous backward integration efforts for import substitution
items.quote: Our total imports are in the range of generally INR600 crores plus/minus -- INR500 crores to INR600 crores. And this we have been maintaining for last 3, 4 years.

items.statement: South India contributes ~40% of brand business; chili market declining this year
items.quote: For us, South contributes roughly about 40% of our brand business. When I say South, I mean Andhra, Telangana, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and also Kerala.

items.statement: Launched SPARCLE with Corteva in August; signed agreements with at least 2 other MNCs for future launches
items.quote: We have just launched a product with Corteva. So there are many agreements signed, whic h I cannot declare till we launch the products actually. As a strategy, we only come out. But I can Insecticides ( just say that, yes, we have signed various contracts with various companies, at least 2 companies or

items.statement: Expects INR60-70 cr sales returns in Q2 from Q1 soybean herbicide inventory; provision already made
items.quote: So the good return, which we may expect in Q2 may be to an extent of about INR60 crores, INR70 crores. So the provision is already made for that.

items.statement: Normal sales return rate ~3%; inventory reducing month-on-month; no heavy channel inventory
items.quote: Generally, we expect a sales return of 3% as a normal routine, what happens to us actually.

items.statement: Hiring senior professionals ongoing; expects joiners before and after Diwali
items.quote: The process is on. We are working. So we are working at various levels. So I expect that, yes, there will be some joining before Diwali and after Diwali also.

items.statement: Quarterly revenue seasonality typically 30%-30%-20%-20%; no dumping in Q4
items.quote: Generally, if we distribute the 4 quarters, this is 30% -30%, 20%-20%. So which is a general definition for -- with respect to Insecticide (India).

items.statement: Raw material price outlook difficult to predict; dependent on global supply chain, weather events
items.quote: Very difficult to say, but we know that we are prepared for the kharif season. So I have already made my mind still for this quarter. So we are very well placed till October.

items.statement: OAT Agrio JV: filed ~12 patents; first product filing in 2025, launch in 2026; IIL has first right of refusal for global manufacturing
items.quote: We have filed about a dozen patents from this JV. The first product, we are planning to make a filing in the year '25, and there can be a launch in the 1 year itself. That is the vision. So the first product will be coming.

items.statement: Export sales 2% of total; expects export business growth in FY26
items.quote: And also, we have some good expectation from the export business, so these businesses will also grow.

items.statement: Factories running at 100% capacity in July-August peak demand period
items.quote: At this moment, with all the factories running at 100% capacity, we are not able to fulfill the market demand.

items.statement: OAT JV first product is an insecticide; trials mainly in Japan; regulatory filings underway
items.quote: It's an insecticide actually. So as it gets launched, the information will be public. So the launch is not in year '25, it will be in the year '26.

items.statement: FY26 production targets: 3.70 MMT crude oil and 3.65 BCM natural gas
items.quote: Now for '25-'26, we have set a target of 3.70 MMT for oil and 3.40 for gas. I mean 3.65 for gas.

items.statement: FY27 production targets: 3.95 MMT crude oil and 4.31 BCM natural gas
items.quote: '27 is 3.95, that's crude oil, MMT. And natural gas would be 4.31.

items.statement: Standalone FY26 capex planned at INR 6,995 crores
items.quote: For '25-'26, we have planned INR6,995 crores or you can say INR7,000 crores.

items.statement: NRL FY26 capex planned at INR 9,133 crores
items.quote: With regard to Numaligarh Refinery, the capital expenditure target for the current year is around INR9,133 crores

items.statement: Standalone FY27 capex planned at INR 7,585 crores
items.quote: OIL would be investing INR7,585 crores, covering the various heads under which the investments will be made

items.statement: NRL FY27 capex planned at INR 7,300 crores
items.quote: And NRL investment would be INR7,300 crores. So total would be INR14,000-plus crores for '26-'27.

items.statement: NRL refinery expansion commissioning to start phased from December 2025
items.quote: the commissioning of the project will start in phased manner from December '25 itself

items.statement: NRL refinery expansion overall physical progress at 80% end of Q1 FY26
items.quote: the overall physical progress of around 80% has been achieved by the end of the quarter 1

items.statement: Crude oil pipeline (CNPCL) physical progress at 84% end of Q1 FY26
items.quote: in case of our CNPCL, that is the crude oil pipeline, we have achieved around 84% of physical progress

items.statement: NRL targeting crude throughput >3 MMT in FY26
items.quote: we are targeting for crude throughput of more than 3 MMT in this year

items.statement: NRL expanded capacity utilization expected ~40% in H2 FY27, ~80% in FY28
items.quote: in the second half of financial year '26, '27, actually additional output from the NREP will start coming in. However, in the initial stage, the production levels will be around 40% additional. And then going forward, we are expecting that in the financial year '27, '28, we will have an output of nearly 80% from the new refinery.

items.statement: Gas offtake affected by customer shutdowns (BPCL, BVFCL, NRL, LPG plant) in Q1
items.quote: BPCL -- VCPL, they have shut down for more than 20 days. Then BVFCL also have shut down. Numaligarh also, some amount they have taken less. So all these are APL, they are taking maintenance up. So these are affecting our production, sir. Now these are now started taking gas.

items.statement: Average crude realization $66.2/bbl in Q1 FY26, down 22% YoY
items.quote: In the current quarter, we had a realization of $66.2 per barrel as compared to $84.89 per barrel.

items.statement: Natural gas price at $6.72/MMBTU aligned with government benchmark
items.quote: The natural gas price stood at 6.72 MMBTU, aligned with the regulatory benchmark has been guided by the Government of India.

items.statement: Crude price outlook: conservative $65-70/bbl range for near term
items.quote: our outlook would be at best, maybe 65 to 70. We are currently hovering at around 66, 67. So we don't expect a major increase in the crude oil price in the days ahead.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin fell from 43% to 34% in Q1 FY26 due to lower revenue and provisions
items.quote: The EBITDA margin has gone down from 43% to 34% in the quarter because of lower revenue and small increase in our operating expenses for providing provisions against our well assets.

items.statement: NRL Q1 GRM $5.02/bbl, hit by $2.93/bbl inventory loss from falling crude prices
items.quote: NRL reported a GRM of $5.02 per barrel in the -- for the period of April to June '25, '26. And we had to take a hit of $2.93 for this particular quarter on account of loss of the value of the inventory

items.statement: Excise duty hike of INR 2/litre on April 7 benefited NRL by INR 118 crores in Q1
items.quote: on 7th of April, the excise duty rates increased by INR2, which has benefited by INR1 in our -- INR1 per liter for both MS and HSD for NRL. In the first quarter, our Northeast -- the impact of the increase in excise duty has been INR118 crores in our profit amount.

items.statement: Russian assets: 95% combined investment recovered via dividends; expect 100% recovery in FY26
items.quote: We have almost recovered close to 95% of our investment combined in these two assets. 111% of investment has been recovered through dividends for the Taas-Yuryakh asset and close to 83% plus dividend -- sorry, investment has been recovered through dividend in Vankorneft asset.

items.statement: Net zero target by 2040 with INR 25,000 crores earmarked for renewables, CBG, solar
items.quote: we have earmarked a sum of INR25,000 crores to kind of achieve our net zero target by the year 2040. So investments will be made in different segments, starting from solar, wind energy. We are also into CBG

items.statement: Planning 1.9 GW solar (645 MW Assam, 1 GW Rajasthan, 200 MW Rajasthan green energy) and 150 MW Himachal solar; target March 2026
items.quote: we are aiming 645 megawatts in Assam, and 1 gigawatt in state of Rajasthan and 200 megawatts green energy projects in Rajasthan. And as far as Himachal Pradesh is concerned, we are already establishing a 1-megawatt capacity of green hydrogen plant in a place called Baddi in Himachal Pradesh.

items.statement: 25 CBG plants planned across states; bioethanol plant inauguration September 8
items.quote: We are in the process of setting up about 25 CBG plants across different states in India. We have already tied up with a few states, already the MOUs and other agreements have already been signed.

items.statement: Requesting ministry to allow new well gas supply to NRL at premium pricing before CGDs develop in Northeast
items.quote: We have made a request to the ministry to let us allow the gas to be lifted by NRL, give us that marketing freedom so that -- see, we are sitting on a reserve of roughly 140 bcm of gas.

items.statement: DNPL expansion to 2.5 MMSCMD pending PNGRB common carrier clearance for IGGL connection
items.quote: Presently, DNPL line is transporting 1 million gas and they have revamped that line and that capacity will ramp up to 2.5 million. And this can be connected to IGGL if they got the PNGRB clearance, common carrier clearance.

items.statement: IGGL feeder line to Duliajan (165 km) projected to MOPNG, target March 2027
items.quote: Already, this is projected to MOPNG. Once that approved, that line will be laid. Our target is March '27.

items.statement: Gas evacuation constrained by upstream connectivity to IGGL; upper end connection pending ministry permission
items.quote: Upper end is not connected yet, we are unable to kind of inject gas into the system so that it can flow to Numaligarh and beyond.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 crude oil production 0.85 MMT (+1.07% QoQ, -2% YoY); gas 0.83 BCM (+2.61% QoQ, +1.1% YoY)
items.quote: The crude oil production for the quarter stood 0.85 million metric tons. There has been a marginal decrease of 2% on year-to-year, but we have been achieving 1.07% on quarter-to-quarter basis increase in production of crude oil. items.quote: Kiddopia ramped up its IP -led content by launching the Barbie game island in April, Baby John Playroom (Moonbug's Little Angel) in May and PJ Masks activities (Hasbro) in June and partnerships with Animaj (Pocoyo) and VOOKS as well . Kiddopia ended this quarter with 227K subscribers as compared to roughly around 228K subscribers at the end of the last quarter .

items.statement: Curve Games has strong relationships with Sony, Microsoft, Steam, Nintendo; coveted publisher for development studios
items.quote: They have extremely strong relationships with all the large platforms like Sony, Microsoft, Steam and Nintendo . And on the development side, they are one of the most coveted publishers f or studios to publish their games .

items.statement: Nodwin aims to be top 1-2 in youth entertainment globally in 3-5 years, currently #3-4, expanding Comic Con to 11 locations and 2-3 new countries
items.quote: We are going to do 11 this year . We just 7 announced that and we continue to go ahead and take it global . We'll be going to more than 2-3 countries as we go forward

items.statement: PokerBaazi profitability depends on market positioning and taxation situation, FY27 target for operating profitability
items.quote: In FY26, we do not expect to deliver profitability for PokerBaazi. In FY27 we should, but it depends on our market positioning at that point of time and what's the right thing to do for the business.

items.statement: Nodwin planning bridge round then larger fundraise, Nazara stake to dilute to 46-47%, Nazara not participating in fundraise
items.quote: So, the exact amounts are still to be finalized so, I won't be able to give you a specific equity position, but it will be in the range of 46 -47% from what I understand at this point of time.

items.statement: Nodwin to raise growth capital independently post deconsolidation, bridge round first then larger raise
items.quote: The deconsolidation is subject to shareholder approval and will enable Nodwin to independently raise growth capital and operate with greater strategic and financial flexibility while allowing Nazara to allocate capital to core gaming bus inesses.

items.statement: Board approved share subdivision 1:2 (face value INR 4 to INR 2) and 1:1 bonus issue
items.quote: Firstly, a subdivision of one equity share of face value ₹4 each into two equity shares of face value ₹2 each, and a bonus issue in the ratio of 1:1.

items.statement: Rohit Sharma appointed Executive Director with 25+ years gaming and digital media experience
items.quote: We also strengthened our leadership team with the appointment of Mr. Rohit Sharma as Executive Director. Rohit brings over 25 years of experience in gaming and digital media and his expertise will be instrumental in advancing our IP -driven growth strategy across genres, platforms and markets.

items.statement: Sportskeeda US organic traffic down 21% YoY post Google March core update, austerity measures implemented, recovery expected in 1-2 quarters
items.quote: Sportskeeda's US organic traffic decline post Google's March core update led to a 21% year-on-year revenue drop to INR 48 .1 crores and EBITDA was INR 5.4 crores, prompting swift cost optimization through content cost renegotiation and rightsizing.

items.statement: PokerBaazi GGR up 46% YoY, GTV up 23%, deposits up 19%, record DAUs and MAUs in Q1 FY26
items.quote: PokerBaazi also delivered strong operating metrics in Q1 with gross gaming revenue (GGR) up 46% year-on-year, gross transactional value up 23% and deposits up 19%.

items.statement: PokerBaazi IPL branding spends INR 85 crores, Shark Tank spends INR 25 crores fully booked in Q1, no further spends in coming quarters
items.quote: The IPL spends were somewhere around INR 85 crores and the Shark Tank spends were around INR 25 crores on top of that.

items.statement: Platform dependence on Apple/Google mitigated by diversified revenue model (IAP, ads, sponsorships), web flows, Curve acquisition diversifying to PC/console platforms
items.quote: One from a Nazara perspective, our business model which includes in-app purchases, advertising revenues as well as sponsorship revenues hedges the risks of these platforms to a certain extent . In addition to that, for example, web flows are being enabled now on a lot of these platforms where you can bill customers directly.

items.statement: Acquired Curve Digital Entertainment for INR 247 crores all-cash, completed Smaaash acquisition via NCLT, Nodwin deconsolidation proposed
items.quote: Nazara acquired 100% equity of Curve Digital Entertainment for an equity value of INR 247 crores in an all-cash deal earlier this year.

items.statement: Gaming revenue seasonality peaks in Q3 (Oct-Dec) due to Christmas holidays in Western markets
items.quote: I think for all gaming businesses the seasonality is the October to December period - which is Q3. It's really the best quarter due to Christmas holidays etc. given a lot of our revenue comes from Western markets.

items.statement: Datawrkz (including Space & Time) reported 313% YoY revenue growth and 283% EBITDA growth, delivering INR 106.1 crores revenue and INR 2.6 crores EBITDA
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, Datawrkz (including Space & Time) reported 313% year-on-year revenue growth and 283% EBITDA growth, delivering 106.1 crores in revenue and INR 2.6 crores in EBITDA in Q1.

items.statement: Other income includes INR 66 crore gain from STAN investment, follow-on $1M investment alongside Google and Bandai Namco in $9-10M round
items.quote: So, we're quite excited about that business and it's growing extremely fast, but the Other Income largely compromises of an INR 66 crore gain on STAN.

items.statement: Targets retail contribution of 5-8% of total revenue by FY26 and 18-20% in 2 years; aims for retail EBITDA breakeven by end of FY26
items.quote: We are on track to have retail contribu tion from close to 5% to 8% to total revenue by FY '26 with clear levers in place to accelerate beyond that

items.statement: Expects overall growth higher than industry peers in coming quarters
items.quote: So, our growth in terms of overall growth, of course, as we have been maintaining, it will be higher than the industry peers, and that is what we aspiration working towards it from the different initiatives that we have done.

items.statement: Rajasthan PPP project capex estimated at INR 200-250 crores over next 12 months
items.quote: So, we look at CAPEX in the range of about INR 200 crores to INR 250 crores, which will help us achieve revenues in the range of about INR 300 crores to INR 350 crores on an annualized basis.

items.statement: Majority of Maharashtra CT and MRI implementation to be completed by end of Q3 FY26
items.quote: So, by end of Q3, majority of the implementation of the Maharashtra CT and MRI will be getting done.

items.statement: Rajasthan PPP award: 42 mother labs, 135 satellite labs, 1,300+ collection centers; full operations targeted by FY26, material revenues from FY27
items.quote: We are proud to announce the Rajasthan award, which is a transformative achievement with 42 mother labs, 135 satellite labs and 1,300-plus collection centers across all districts targeted for full operations by FY '26 with material revenues starting from FY '27.

items.statement: Rajasthan project rollout over 6-9 months; revenue expected from next financial year
items.quote: In terms of the project ramp -up, we expect the ramp -up to start in the next couple of months, which will probably take about 6 to 9 months, and the revenue will start flowing from the next financial year.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 120 bps YoY to 27%; PAT margin 11%
items.quote: This performance resulting in a 120 basis point expansion in our EBITDA margin, w hich now stands at 27%.

items.statement: Expects sustainable EBITDA margins of 25-26% even with Rajasthan revenue share increase
items.quote: You are right. The EBIT DA margins will be the same level. There won't be an impact on the EBITDA because of the revenue share.

items.statement: Retail touchpoints surged 7x YoY from 362 to 2,414; retail revenue growing sharply, now 6% of group revenue
items.quote: Our touch points have surged from 362 to 2,414 on a year-on-year basis, and the retail revenue has grown sharply. Our B2C contribution has increased meaningfully. The retail now contributes 6% of our overall group revenues.

items.statement: Volume growth subdued at ~4% YoY due to BMC contract exit and suspended projects; expects improvement in coming quarters
items.quote: If you see the volume that you are referring to subdued is majorly which if you compare on a like-for-like, it was the BMC, which was in the past. But also, there are some of the projects that we suspend the operations, these have resulted.

items.statement: Offers diagnostics at 70-90% below market prices while maintaining peer-comparable margins via PPP-retail hybrid shared infrastructure
items.quote: Our moat is clear. We offer high-quality diagnostics at 70% to 90% below the prevailing market prices and still deliver margins which are comparable to the peers, powered by a PPP and retail hybrid shared infrastructure and disciplined execution.

items.statement: Receivables at ~120 days; received overdue payments from Himachal Pradesh and Karnataka with official confirmations; working capital improved and expected to improve further
items.quote: Our receivable for Q1 FY '26 are at around 120 days. We are also pleased to share that we have started receiving long over dues payments from Himachal Pradesh and Karnataka. Furthermore, we have received official confirmations of the pending amount from these and other states.

items.statement: Rajasthan project expected working capital cycle of 90-120 days
items.quote: No, I think Rajasthan historically had a good working capital cycle. So, we expect within 90 to 120 days.

items.statement: Evaluating internal accruals, debt at efficient cost, and leasing/reagent rental models to fund Rajasthan capex
items.quote: So, we are currently evaluating multiple options, like I just mentioned earlier, it will be a combination of our internal accruals. If required, we are also exploring debt at some very efficient cost of capital as well as certain of these leasing or reagent rental models.

items.statement: Operationalized 3 labs, 2 CTs, 3 MRIs in Q1 FY26; 7-8 MRI sites in Maharashtra/MP/UP plus Jharkhand radiology, CT, MRI, pathology in Q2
items.quote: So, in this quarter, we operationalized 3 labs and 2 CTs and 3 MRI, all put together. And in the coming quarter, certainly, the remaining 7 or 8 MRI sites in Maharashtra, including Madhya Pradesh and one will be in the UP will be getting implemented.

items.statement: On completion of current order book, will operate 200+ CT/MRI centers, ranking among Asia's largest
items.quote: On completion of our current order book, we will be operating 200 -plus CT scan MRI centers ranking among Asia's largest.

items.statement: Retail strategy focuses on B2C (direct-to-patient) as core, with B2B adding accessibility; B2C revenue higher than B2B
items.quote: So, while as our philosophy goes with the leveraging our overall PPP infrastructure that we have and which is more towards the direct-to-consumer or direct-to-patient approach. So, B2C has always remained core to us.

items.statement: Exited BMC tender due to unfavorable financial viability; prioritizes value creation over volume
items.quote: On the BMC side, we had participated earlier, but when the tender conditions, which we believe are not favorable in terms of overall financial viability , and therefore, we did not continue.

items.statement: Revenue per test in Rajasthan similar to existing tenders initially; expects increase as project matures
items.quote: So, in the current setup, Rajasthan tender, the revenue per test would be more or less in the similar ranges. But as the tender matures, the project matures, we expect the revenue per patient also to increase.

items.statement: Q1 FY26: 5 million patients served, 16 million tests processed
items.quote: We achieved this by serving 5 million patients and processing almost 16 million tests at our various facilities.

items.statement: Apulki partnership: 30-year revenue visibility; Pune hospital commercial in couple of months, second hospital under construction; deploying CT, MRI, pathology (no PET scan)
items.quote: As you also are aware, cancer and cardiac cases are on the rise. And this also gives us a foot in the door in terms of Krsnaa centers being there in urban dense areas as well as capturing the oncology market, so to speak.

items.statement: Karnataka revenue impacted by procedural changes by government; Himachal Pradesh stable and improving
items.quote: Karnataka, there were certain procedural changes done by the government , because of which the Karnataka revenue came down. But Himachal is continuing at the existing levels and in fact, improved.

items.statement: Adding manpower for retail business rollout; marketing, digitization, automation investments ongoing
items.quote: Further to that, adding up the further manpower to the business as a retail business to reach out to the desired audience, it is adding up the cost.

items.statement: Rajasthan project is purely pathology (no radiology); higher revenue-to-investment ratio vs blended radiology-pathology projects
items.quote: So, if I understood you correctly, in terms of the investment versus the revenue, Rajasthan is a purely pathology project, wherein there are pathology labs to be established where pathology collection centers to be established.

items.statement: Phase 1 commercial production started at new Panchla facility; Phase 2 on schedule for H2 FY26; cell culture revenue expected from Q4 FY26 with full ramp-up over next 2 years
items.quote: Phase 1 of commercial production at our new facility has already started and with Phase 2 on schedule to commence operations in the second half of this year. We anticipate initial revenue contribution from our cell culture to begin in Q4 of this year with full-scale ramp-up expected in the next 2 financial years.

items.statement: Current capacity utilization around 75-80%; existing capacity can support 15-20% revenue growth; new facilities add INR 350-400 crores revenue potential; Panchla facility 25-30% capacity expansion, 70% new products
items.quote: We don't exactly know what our capacity utilization is because different moulds with different machines can yield different outputs for us, but we believe in the region of 75%-80%. We have capacities of 15% to 20%, which our revenues can grow by 15% to 20% with our existing capacity. We do have the installed capacity in our new facilities, which can help us generate additional revenues of about IN

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin 31.2% in Q1 FY26 (up 490 bps YoY, 30 bps adjusted); consolidated EBITDA margin 27% (up 140 bps adjusted); targets 33-35% EBITDA margin yearly, inching to 40% after new facilities stabilize
items.quote: Standalone EBITDA margin for Q1 FY '26 stood at 31.2% versus 26.3% in Q1 FY '25 reflecting an improve of 490 basis points. After adjusting for the one-time expenses, margin in Q1 FY '25 was 30.9%. Accordingly, the improvement in margin from Q1 FY '25 to Q1 FY '26 would come to around 30 basis point.

items.statement: Management expects yearly EBITDA margins around 33-35% currently, inching towards 40% after new facilities stabilize
items.quote: I think the margins on a yearly basis look at somewhere around 33% to 35% EBITDA at this point of time. Once we are able to stabilize our operations at both our new facilities, I think we could inch towards the 40% EBITDA margin.

items.statement: Significant portion of retained earnings will be used to pare down debt after new capacity added
items.quote: No, actually, we will always use it for R&D and trying to plan for the future, but a significant portion of the retained earnings of the company will be used to pare down the debt.

items.statement: Depreciation expected at INR 80-85 crores for FY26 due to Panchla facility capitalization
items.quote: We are expecting a depreciation of at around INR 80 crores to INR 85 crores in FY '26.

items.statement: US market ~10-12% of consolidated revenue; 25% tariff effective soon, 50% later; new order momentum slowed in last 2 weeks due to tariff uncertainty
items.quote: The U.S. is a very important market for Tarsons. It's not a large portion of revenue, but it's a very important portion of revenue at about 10% to 12% of our consolidated revenues.

items.statement: Export order book robust despite soft overseas market; revenue spillover from June to July due to bill of lading timing
items.quote: While the overseas market was relatively soft for this quarter, but the order book in the export market is relatively robust. The overseas business can see some lag in revenues on account of dispatches and delivery schedules.

items.statement: Panchla Phase 1 mainly capacity expansion for existing liquid handling products plus some new suspension/media bottles for cell culture; Phase 2 focused on cell culture and bioprocess
items.quote: That is for existing products for certain liquid handling products and certain new products as well, which is related to suspension bottles for use for cell culture as well as media bottles. It's a mix where there are very few new products, but mainly capacity expansion of older products.

items.statement: Domestic competition intense due to sluggish market and underutilized capacities at peers; Tarsons maintaining leadership via distribution reach and brand preference; no price hikes possible currently
items.quote: See, the competition in the domestic market is highly increased. The reason for that is sluggish market conditions, both domestically and internationally. While we face the heat being one of the relatively larger companies in India, there are various middl e-sized, large-sized companies like us and even small-sized companies which are facing highly underutilized capacities at their facility

items.statement: Distributor inventory levels 15-40 days depending on scale and region; large SKU count drives inventory needs; no direct customer warehousing
items.quote: It could vary between 15 days to 40 days, depending on distributor scale, distributor size and the region.

items.statement: Nerbe (Germany) revenue flat at INR 20 crores in Q1 FY26 due to European budget constraints and election delays; Tarsons products export to Nerbe started but negligible revenue; focus on white-label via Nerbe targeting EUR 5M inter-company
items.quote: Nerbe, our Germany -based Europe-focused entity acquired in FY '24, reported a flat revenue growth for the period. This was primarily due to budget constraints in the region as well as several European countries, including Germany, experiencing delays in sp ending amidst government elections, which in turn impacted performance

items.statement: No public revenue guidance given; internal targets exist but not disclosed; FY28 revenue capacity ~INR 800 crores with new facilities but not a target
items.quote: I'm not sure about the target. This is not a target which the company has set or publicly definitely said. We have our internal targets as a company, but we don't give any kind of guidance to the public markets and what our target is for FY '27, '28 or any other financial year.

items.statement: Panchla facility optimum utilization (70-75%) expected in 3 years from full commercialization (~FY29); international business must contribute 55-60% of new facility revenue
items.quote: 3 years is what we look at from the date of complete commercialization where we should reach about 70%-75% utilization, which we consider optimum. Chirag Maroo: Broadly, can I say that by FY '29, we would be at 70%-75% utilization? Aryan Sehgal: Hopefully, because, see, again, what we need to consider is that if we look at the kind of products what we are building in Panchla and Amta, I believe th

items.statement: Standalone revenue INR 71 crores (+10% YoY); consolidated revenue INR 91 crores (+8% YoY); domestic +12% YoY, export +3% YoY; standalone EBITDA INR 22 crores (+31% YoY, +11% adjusted); consolidated EBITDA INR 25 crores (+13.5% adjusted)
items.quote: Stand alone revenue from operations for Q1 FY '26 stood at INR 71 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 10%. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter was INR 91 crores, marking a growth of around 8% compared to Q1 FY '25.

items.statement: Standalone PAT INR 3.6 crores (down from INR 6.5 crores) due to higher depreciation INR 17.8 crores vs INR 9 crores; cash PAT INR 21 crores (+38% YoY); consolidated PAT INR 1.8 crores, cash PAT INR 21.7 crores (+44% YoY)
items.quote: Standalone PAT for Q1 FY '26 stood at INR 3.6 crores compared to INR 6.5 crores in Q1 FY '25. The decline in PAT is driven by higher depreciation expenses of INR 17.8 crores compared to INR 9 crores in Q1 FY '25 due to the capitalisation of Panchla facility.

items.statement: No price hikes taken or planned in next 3-6 months; market too competitive with underutilized peer capacities
items.quote: No, absolutely not. I think the market does not have the appetite to digest any kind of price increases at this point of time. As I mentioned, your statement is quite accurate, but not 100%. The market is brutally competitive at this point of time, and eve rybody is fighting for price because of large underutilized capacities at various players

items.statement: No new MNC or domestic player heard planning cell culture plant in India; Tarsons differentiating via new products and strategies for commoditized consumables
items.quote: See, I have not heard any rumours of anyone planning to do so, but apart from that, if anyone has other plans which are not known to the public, I will not be aware of it. As of now, no. I think with more and more new products, we're looking to differentiate ourselves and elevate ourselves from the competition in the market.

items.statement: FY26 handover guidance of 3,300-3,600 units and revenue of INR 1,250-1,300 crores
items.quote: we have about 9 or 10 projects account for this 3,800 units. A big part will come from Kolkata, 1,400 units and which is Sunshine 1. And then Bangalore will have about 1,800 units will come from Bangalore and rest is in Chennai

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin target of ~25% and PBT margin of 8-11%
items.quote: We have consistently maintained over the years that we will aspire and we will continue to drive towards gross margin of 30%, EBITDA margins of about 25%, PBT margins of about 8% to 11%.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 sales volume 0.82 msf, value INR 441 crores, up 17% YoY
items.quote: Q1 sales volume reached 0.82 million square feet, up 17% year -on-year. In value terms, we achieved sales value of INR 441 crores, again, by 17% up year-on-year.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 collections INR 338 crores, highest ever Q1
items.quote: collections at INR 338 crores is the highest in any Q1 so far and is driven by healthy sales handover and milestone linked receipts.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 EBITDA INR 47 crores at 18% margin
items.quote: EBITDA stood at INR 47 crores with an 18% margin.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 construction spend INR 111 crores, new project investment INR 75 crores
items.value: INR 111 crores construction; INR 75 crores new projects
items.quote: We deployed INR 111 crores into construction and INR 75 crores into new project investment.

items.statement: Pune debut project Codename Superstar sold 150+ units (36% of launch supply) in first 4 weeks
items.quote: The project has delivered at least INR 600/sft more than our initial expectation we had while buying this land about a year ago.

items.statement: Bangalore project Codename The One launched July 2025 at INR 92.99 lakhs starting price, strong pre-launch response
items.quote: It features signature 2 and 3 residences starting at an attractive price point of INR 92.99 lakhs, making it highly competitive in its segment.

items.statement: Kolkata project Shriram Springfield approvals in place, pre-sales overwhelming, launch imminent
items.quote: In Kolkata, approvals for Shriram Springfield are in place and the recent presales effort have received overwhelming response and is being launched shortly.

items.statement: Target to double project pipeline over 18-24 months; 20+ msf under evaluation
items.quote: Further projects with 20+ million square feet at various stage of evaluation across core markets. This wider funnel provides option value and a multiyear runway, allowing us to stay selective while still aiming to double the upcoming pipeline over 18 to 24 months.

items.statement: Gross debt INR 567 crores, net debt INR 380 crores, net D/E 0.28; no significant debt increase expected
items.value: INR 567 crores gross; INR 380 crores net; 0.28 D/E
items.quote: Gross debt stood at INR 567 crores, down from INR 646 crores in March 2025 with a net debt of INR 380 crores. Our net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.28 among the lowest in the sector.

items.statement: Price hikes limited to 1-3% in micro markets; era of double-digit hikes over
items.quote: During the quarter, we would have seen couple of percent increase, 1% or 2% in some micro markets and 2% to 3% in other micro markets. So the prices are not going anywhere this year.

items.statement: End-user demand resilient in mid/mid-premium segments; Chennai revival, Bangalore supply-driven recovery
items.quote: Underlying demand remains strong. I don't think a huge momentum loss is there, at least in our core markets of Bangalore, Chennai, even in Pune that we have seen. I n fact, it has picked

items.statement: Government royalty decision expected soon; path clear but timeline uncertain
items.quote: As I said in my May call, we think we have made a meaningful progress. The final decision outcome is expected. As is with any government, it is expected any time, but it has not come through for the last couple of quarters.

items.statement: Q1 FY26 handovers 740+ units, highest ever Q1; FY26 target 3,300-3,600 units
items.quote: Over 740 units have been handed over to customers, again, highest ever Q1 number for SPL.

items.statement: JV/DM projects contributed 46% of Q1 handovers; ~1,000 JV units targeted for FY26
items.quote: Our JV portfolio also contributed meaningfully with a profit share of INR 5 crores, representing 46% of total handovers in Q1 coming from JV projects.

items.statement: Added 1 Bangalore project GDV INR 200 crores in Q1; 6 projects (3 msf) nearing closure Q2-Q3; 5 projects (3+ msf) advanced commercial closure H2
items.value: INR 200 crores GDV added; 6 projects 3 msf; 5 projects 3+ msf
items.quote: During Q1, we added 1 project in Bangalore with GDV of INR 200 crores within a short period of acquisition, approval process has started ahead, and it is expected to launch in H2 FY26. 6 projects totaling 3 million square feet are nearing closure. 5 projects totaling around 3+ million square feet of projects are at an advanced stage of commercial closure.

items.statement: ASK platform has INR 135-140 crores remaining investment scope; new fund discussions underway
items.quote: We already have at least scope for another INR 135-140 crores of investment that can be made from the existing platform itself. We are working towards deploying that soon.

items.statement: No significant IT layoff impact seen; GCC growth compensating; demand contraction only if IT sector collapses
items.quote: We don't think there will be a demand contraction in the near future, unless the IT sector collapses. Then, there will be a confidence crisis in the minds of customer and that might lead to.

items.statement: No immediate plan to increase promoter holding; SEBI-approved inter-promoter transfer in progress
items.quote: There is no immediate plan to increase promoter holding. As you know, there's a transaction which is already approved by SEBI and it is in the working, in terms of inter promoter transfers.

items.statement: Royalty savings ~INR 4 crores annually (5% of PBT) as brand usage phased out
items.quote: Annually, we have incurred about 5% of PBT in the past, which is about INR 4 crores or something that was the number the annual run rate we had in the past couple of years. To that extent, we'll save during this year.

items.statement: Q1 was difficult with continuing softness in consumer demand aggravated by trade working capital pressure from cooling products slowdown in April-May, recovery only in June
items.quote: Q1 was a difficult and challenging period. There was a continuing softness in consumer demand, which was aggravated by pressure on trade working capital owing to the slowdown in cooling products, especially in April and May, and it was only in June that we saw some recovery.

items.statement: Product business grew double-digit in both volume and value in Q1 FY26
items.quote: Overall revenues grew by 9.9% on the back of a double -digit growth in our products business. This growth was driven by a double -digit volume growth in both our key categories of EWPs and VCs.

items.statement: Economy and premium EWP segments grew strongly; robotics vacuum cleaners grew 52%
items.quote: We saw 52% growth in robotics, and this helped drive the vacuum cleaner category to strong double-digit growth.

items.statement: Service bookings grew double-digit driven by AMC count growth, ASP increase, and higher multi-year booking mix
items.quote: We had a healthy double -digit growth in fresh service bookings. This growth came from a combination of growth in AMC count and an increase in the ASP. We also saw an increase in the number of multi-year bookings.

items.statement: Expect double-digit service bookings growth to sustain in coming quarters
items.quote: As we look ahead at the periods ahead, we feel very confident that we will see double -digit growth in service bookings sustained and all the efforts that we've made and that we continue to put in, in service transformation, picking up pace and helping us drive growth.

items.statement: Service bookings growth to reflect in reported revenue from Q4 FY26
items.quote: In terms of impact in the P&L, you can expect to see the numbers show up in the reported numbers by Q 4 of this year.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin at 11% in Q1 after higher service charge payouts and growth investments; PAT grew 24.1%
items.quote: On the profitability side, the adjusted EBITDA margins for Q1 came in at 11%, after accounting for higher service charge payouts and with the increased growth investments. Our profit after tax grew by 24.1% over last year.

items.statement: Gross margin at 59.7% in Q1, range-bound vs 60.5% last year; tactical promotions impacted margin
items.quote: Our Q1 gross margins at 59.7% were range bound versus 60.5% last year and 20 basis points higher on a sequential basis. Commodity costs remained benign for most parts. Given the challenging market conditions in the quarter, tactical promotions were run, which led to a gross margin drop.

items.statement: Expect gross margins to remain range-bound with multiple levers including product-service mix, price points, and cost management
items.quote: We bel ieve that our structural advantages and guardrails on gross margin in the form of a healthy product and service mix, portfolios straddling various price points and effective cost management, give us several levers on gross margin

items.statement: Aim for full-year margin improvement in FY26, not pushed to FY27
items.quote: There should be absolutely no doubt whether the margin expansion agenda is being pushed to FY 27, certainly not. It very much remains part of the ambition for FY 26.

items.statement: Filter manufacturing done in-house at Dehradun and Bangalore factories with abundant capacity for foreseeable growth
items.quote: All our manufacturing of filters, et cetera, is done in-house. We have 2 factories, as you know, one in Dehradun, one in Bangalore, and it's all done in-house. We have abundant capacity to accommodate for filter growth in the foreseeable future.

items.statement: Expanding service network of partners and technicians is ongoing work stream as category penetration grows
items.quote: Expanding our service network and growing the service capacity is an ongoing work stream that will continue in the foreseeable future. We have a very large and a very, very, I think, capable and a very solid network of business partners and technicians in our existing markets, and we intend to strengthen our partnership with them.

items.statement: Launched 2-year filter life EWPs across economy to premium segments; now have over 40 such products
items.quote: During the quarter, we scale d up our range of EWPs with two- year filter life. These products significantly lowered the lifetime cost of ownership, and we are confident that they will help drive penetration and growth for us. We now have more than 40 products that offer two -year filter life.

items.statement: Scaled up smart IoT-enabled premium EWP range in Q1
items.quote: In the premium segment of EWPs, we scaled up our smart IoT-enabled range during the quarter.

items.statement: D2C channel now accounts for nearly 2/3 of AMC bookings, up from 10-12% previously
